value: Per-tick settings are in ticks.csv; *AtStart values are the first recorded tick of the session.
units.csv values are first-sight snapshots captured while recording; exportTime_* columns were read from the asset at export time.
ai_* columns use PowerMath (what the AI uses); balsim_* use BalanceSimulationRunner helpers. They are different approximations and are not expected to match.
Blank cells mean not applicable or not derivable (NaN/Infinity are written as blank).
Plan captures are retained independently of tick ring rollover, up to 500 plans. Open inspector and enable Record before starting AI.
Wait categories are diagnostic inferences. Exact cooldown requires a recorded pass or a future authoritative cooldown API.
